mapper.select: select ID_ as definition_id, DEPLOYMENT_ID_ as deployment_id, SUSPENSION_STATE_ as suspension_state from ACT_RE_PROCDEF force index (ACT_UNIQ_PROCDEF) where KEY_ = #{processKey} and TENANT_ID_ = '' order by VERSION_ desc, DERIVED_VERSION_ desc limit 1 for update
select ID_ from ACT_RE_DEPLOYMENT where ID_ = #{deploymentId} for update

select 1 from ACT_RU_EXECUTION runtime_instance inner join ACT_RE_PROCDEF definition on definition.ID_ = runtime_instance.PROC_DEF_ID_ where definition.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ = #{deploymentId} and runtime_instance.PARENT_ID_ is null limit 1 for update

select 1 from ACT_HI_PROCINST historic_instance inner join ACT_RE_PROCDEF definition on definition.ID_ = historic_instance.PROC_DEF_ID_ where definition.DEPLOYMENT_ID_ = #{deploymentId} limit 1 for update
